headlines.title: Childhood vaccine exemptions for personal or religious reasons hit new record, CDC finds
headlines.description: The number of parents in the U.S. choosing not to vaccinate their children rose dramatically in the last school year, according to data released Monday by the CDC.

headlines.title: Facial Acupuncture Benefits: Reduce Tension, Reset Cortisol, More
headlines.description: Dr. Taz Bhatia joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share how facial acupuncture can release tension, reset cortisol and more.

headlines.title: Assisted Stretching: What to Know About the New Wellness Trend
headlines.description: One of the hottest trends in wellness is assisted stretching with recovery practices popping up all across the country. Two professional stretch therapists from Stretch*d in New York City, join TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to demonstrate some hip and back stretches and explain the numerous benefits for opening everything up.

headlines.title: Meet the Mom Behind Cardio Work Out That Creates Community
headlines.description: Meet Elena Surratt, the mom putting strollers to good use in her class Stroller Bodies, a dance cardio workout designed for moms looking to find community while getting a workout in. She shares how she started the class after battling postpartum depression. “It gave me my spark back,” she says. Then, Elena teaches TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones a couple of her Stroller Bodies moves.

headlines.title: What Parents Should Know About Trump’s Change to Vaccinations
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s new executive order cuts the number of vaccines recommended for all children from 18 to 11. The administration cites rising autism rates for the change, though rigorous studies over decades have shown no link between vaccines and autism. NBC’s medical contributor Dr. John Torres reports in this week’s Sunday Focus on what families should know about vaccines as students head back to school.

headlines.title: Cécred’s just launched a new face product: Here’s everything you need to know
headlines.description: Cécred’s new Lash & Brow Builder is a daily growth serum for fuller eyebrows and eyelashes, and is available to shop on the brand’s website starting today.

headlines.title: Do bathroom sink filters benefit your skin? I asked experts
headlines.description: Bathroom sink filters remove chlorine, heavy metal minerals and other impurities from water. Experts share how they benefit skin.

headlines.title: Ticks that cause Lyme and other diseases have migrated south. Are doctors ready?
headlines.description: New research from the CDC finds that ticks that cause diseases keep marching into new areas.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order aiming to cut the number of required vaccines for children
headlines.description: The order reaffirms the dramatic overhaul to the vaccine schedule that Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced this year. Those changes have been blocked in court.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
headlines.description: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.
